**In this Director of Legal role, you’ll be…

**

• Serving as the legal partner to Sales by driving commercial SaaS contracting, handling T&Cs, MSAs, and DPAs, negotiating deviations, and maintaining fallback negotiation playbooks.

• Managing corporate legal matters, including entity management across international markets, governance, board support, and selective coordination with external counsel.

• Supporting the company's compliance framework in close partnership with our existing Compliance function, with a path toward taking over internal compliance ownership in the near future.

• Owning vendor and supplier contracting by reviewing and negotiating key terms on liability, security, privacy, and SLAs alongside Finance and Operations.

• Building and scaling a lean legal operating model by proactively driving processes, internal guidance, and review triggers to keep legal operations efficient.

• Supporting fundraising rounds, corporate structuring, and M&A initiatives in close collaboration with the CFO and leadership team.

**Who is the Legal Team?

**Sitting within Finance & Operations, the Legal function drives our overall legal direction while remaining hands-on in building a scalable framework that supports our rapid growth across European markets. We safeguard the company across commercial SaaS contracting, corporate law, international scaling, and vendor management, while supporting future fundraising and M&A activities.

We act as a close partner to executive stakeholders, Sales, Finance, and Security, balancing fast risk-reward decisions with robust corporate governance. You will work directly with the Chief Financial Officer and lead our Corporate Lawyer in an environment that values extreme ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and strong cross-functional collaboration to enable business velocity.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by protecting the business and providing the legal backbone needed to scale our platform across international markets safely and efficiently.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Ideally, +5-10 years of relevant legal experience in a similar role, with proven exposure to a fast-growing SaaS environment that has scaled internationally.

• A hands-on, autonomous mindset with the drive to take full ownership of the legal function and scale it from the current setup.

• Strong expertise in commercial SaaS contracting and negotiating client-facing terms.

• GDPR and data privacy expertise, with experience maintaining compliance frameworks.

• Experience with corporate law and governance (board and shareholder matters, entity management), plus exposure to fundraising and M&A processes alongside external counsel.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with a strong grasp of risk-reward balance to keep sales velocity high while protecting the business.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in English (Danish is not a requirement).

**What do we offer you?

**

• A starting salary of 115,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 130,000 DKK per month.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa and relocation support if needed.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

**Our recruitment process

**

• 30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner

• 30-minute online interview with our CFO

• Completion of Personality Assessment & Case Presentation

• 60-minute in-person final case interview with our CFO & other relevant stakeholders

• Cultural interview with relevant stakeholders across the organisation

**About Formalize

**Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, Munich & Paris. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

• Contribute to forecasting and planning processes, helping identify opportunities and areas requiring further analysis.

• Deliver analyses and recommendations to management, highlighting performance trends, risks, and opportunities.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and collaborate with teams across our business units, group functions, and senior leadership. Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us.

jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

**Our purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

**What You'll Do

**

• Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

**Success looks like

**

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

**What You'll Bring With You

****Critical competencies

**

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

**Experience We Would Like To See

**We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• Some exposure to automated testing

• Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

**How We Use AI In This Hiring Process

**We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

**

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

**AI Academy Intake - Copenhagen (on-site, full-time)

**At Light, we're redefining how software is built, how it's delivered, and how it works.

We're building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it's used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy run on Light. We're building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

The AI Academy

The AI Academy is where Light builds its future leaders for an ever-changing world. It's a small cohort of exceptional early-career people who take an operating process in marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success, product or any other team, and rebuild it so AI agents do the work and humans handle the exceptions. Then they move on to the next one.

We believe roles will increasingly merge, and that cross-functional collaboration and broad knowledge of the business will define high-performing teams. The Academy is built around that:

• Training. You start with a period of training on how to use AI to drive business outcomes: tools, agents, automations, and how to judge their output.

• Several functions at once. You then apply it across several functions, splitting your time between teams such as marketing, sales, finance, partnerships, customer success and product.

• Focus. Over time you move into fewer functions, where you've had the most impact and want to go deepest.

In this role you're a member of Light's AI Academy. You'll undergo specialised AI training and be pushed to use AI in every aspect of your job and to re-think the status quo from first principles.

This training will enable you to effectively build operations and companies at scale. If you aspire to be a future single-person unicorn founder, this is the ideal training ground.

**Who This Is For

**You must meet this requirement: an exceptional level of achievement in a highly competitive endeavour. Work experience in itself is irrelevant, past hires have been 17 years and older. For example:

• A gold medal at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI)

• Experience at McKinsey QuantumBlack, the Goldman Sachs Special Situations Group or TMT group (regular IBD do not apply), Optiver, Jane Street or similar.

• Having built or sold a company

• Competed in elite-level sport (e.g. a sub-8-hour Ironman, the Olympic Games, or a European or World Championship, football or basketball at highest level)

• A FIDE chess rating of 2,400 or higher (IM level)

• An equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour

• Top of class in high-school year

If you're applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you don't have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar at Light is high, and this is more than just a job. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

We hold two bars: outperforming your metrics, and being kind and supportive of each other. Exceptional ability without kindness is not a fit.

What you'll work on

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

What we offer

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.
